facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2015-0018 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 29 January 2015 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including INC-2018-015. response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
